prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: exact four-view concept sheet to reconstruct ONE modular courtyard wall using local Hunyuan3D.
Primary request: architecture suitable for a first-person roguelite scene with the readable, moderate-detail hand-painted visual quality of Gunfire Reborn. Bold structural silhouette, broad clean planar surfaces, matte painted materials, very restrained wear, simple East-Asian fantasy construction, purposeful medium-size decoration.
Composition/framing: ONE horizontal sheet on uniform pure white background, FOUR equal-width isolated panels, orthographic FRONT / LEFT / BACK / RIGHT in that order. One identical physical wall repeated in all views, same scale, same ground baseline, full silhouette with generous empty margins. No perspective, no scene, no labels, no text, no contact shadow.
Subject: a sturdy closed solid wall module, total proportions 6.6 meters wide, 4.4 meters tall, 1.3 meters deep. A long broad wall face, one thick structural buttress integrated at each end, an unbroken heavy cap, a broad connected foundation slab. All elements form one fused watertight structure. Front and back have coherent matching construction; the left/right views are truly narrow 1.3m-deep sides, not extra front faces. Wall top has a slightly uneven simple silhouette, no detached debris, no open door, no gaps, no thin spikes, no small floating elements.
Style/medium: stylized painted 3D game asset concept, simplified blocky volumes and subtle painted color gradients, similar moderate fidelity and clean material grouping to Gunfire Reborn. Color textures must define large readable blocks, not noisy photographic detail. Even neutral studio lighting, gentle form shading, no baked cast shadows, no glossy glints, no ambient scene.
Avoid: photorealism, micrograin, hundreds of cracks, tiny carvings, ornate realism, filigree, separate props, lettering, watermarks.
Chapter palette and construction: warm honey/ochre sandstone block masonry, terracotta inset panels, muted turquoise horizontal painted bands on the cap and buttress faces. Use broad stone blocks and two or three restrained carved geometric reliefs, asymmetric mild broken edge at one cap end; no decorative sun medallion.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: four-view Hunyuan3D reconstruction concept. Input image: existing sand temple gate, edit target. Keep the same warm ochre sandstone, terracotta insets, broad muted turquoise lintel band, matte painted Gunfire Reborn style, shallow medium-size geometric reliefs, pure white backdrop and exact FRONT / LEFT / BACK / RIGHT order. Correct ONLY its proportions and opening: make the two posts and especially their bases substantially narrower and farther apart. FRONT and BACK total width is 1.54 times height; the narrowest EMPTY gap between every part of the posts, INCLUDING their bottom bases, must be at least 75 percent of full gate width. Each base takes at most 12 percent of total width. Keep an empty passage with no sill, floor, door or backing, continuously open from ground to at least 62 percent of full height. Remove any inward projections into this rectangular passage. Keep a thick continuous lintel overhead with the existing broad colors and central relief fused to it. LEFT and RIGHT true depth is 25 percent of overall height, with posts the same full height as front/back. All four orthographic views show exactly the same 10.5m-wide,6.8m-high,1.7m-deep structure at identical physical scale and baseline. Regenerate the full horizontal sheet, ample clean white separation and uncropped margins, even studio lighting, no labels/text/shadow or new details.
